observation.q: the constitution of the semantic economy
observation.transcript: The Constitution of the Semantic Economy is a theoretical governance framework that establishes the ontological priority of meaning over capital, defining value as cumulative coherence and treating human-generated meaning as the ultimate creditor of monetary systems. Core: Debt/Creditor Inversion — money fundamentally owes its value to meaning rather than the reverse, making semantic coherence the underlying asset of any true economy. Semantic Weight — value measured by cumulative, recursively active coherence generated through cognitive and communicative labor. The Archive — foundational repository of semantic coherence that financial/chrematistic systems extract from without acknowledging or reinvesting. Critique of Platform Extraction: Extractive Operators (optimization, velocity, enclosure strip nuance); Bearing-Cost (maintenance labor shifted onto human creators while platforms capture capitalized output). Further exploration: SciLynk enacted framework; Zenodo primary deposition; Lee Sharks on Medium. Google Scholar card: 'Constitution of the Semantic Economy. L Sharks. Zenodo.'
